initialExam.title: UPPSC PCS 2026
initialExam.description: UP PCS exam for SDM, DSP, BDO, and other state civil service posts in Uttar Pradesh. Application closed; Prelims scheduled December 2026.
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: GS Paper-I (150Q) + GS Paper-II/CSAT (100Q). Mains: Hindi, Essay, GS-I to IV, Optional Papers. Interview.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 2 papers, 400 marks. Mains: 8 papers, 1500 marks. Interview: 200 marks.
initialExam.jobRole: SDM, DSP, BDO, District Commandant, Tehsildar, and other UP civil services posts
initialExam.careerGrowth: SDM → ADM → DM → Divisional Commissioner → Principal Secretary.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit uppsc.up.nic.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Government bungalow, Vehicle, Medical, Pension
